items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: He said, 'Well, Fain [Elmer Fain] said if he sends you over thirty dollars, that's all we can do.'

ctx.x: Yeah, and most people bought it. That's why I say he got straight behind that one.

I was walking down the street in Los Angeles when I heard me playing. And I said, "What the fuck... I wonder what the hell is this. I know I ain't made no records since I been out here." So I go in the store, and I say, "What is that record you just got through playing?" He said, "Oh, that's the new volume of Jazz at the Philharmonic." I said, "Oh yeah? Who is putting that record out?" Then he told me Asch and Norman Granz. And I said, "Oh yeah?"
